result.summary: The page layout appears intact with no significant visual defects. The partially visible carousel items at the right edge and the truncated card at the bottom are expected scrolling/overflow behavior. One minor content clarity issue exists in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promo banner reads "3 free deliveries for you" but also specifies a minimum order of €10, making the headline potentially misleading.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer wording, e.g. "Get 3 free deliveries over €10" or "€10 off your next 3 orders", so the minimum order value is clear upfront.
